_about: Icons for the boons that come from no item (meals and tonics show their own item's icon), keyed by the start of the boon's id (PlayerBoons), for Tools/LocalSpawn/generate_item_icons.py --set boons; AgentScripts/BuildUIArt.cs puts them in Resources/ConditionIconSettings.
haven_rested: A soft straw bed with a folded wool blanket and a feather pillow under a small crescent moon
festival: A garland of wildflowers and birch leaves wound around a small carved wooden horn of mead
offering: A small flat offering stone with a bowl of berries, bread and a lit candle on it
place: A tall standing stone carved with a glowing warm golden rune, a little moss at its foot
event: A small carved bone charm hanging on a red cord, glowing faintly gold
technique: A green leaf with a small winged leather boot beside it, a faint golden glow
boon: A round bronze amulet on a leather cord, a radiant sun symbol embossed on it
